items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He came into the nightclub with Bobby Cranshaw. Quartet. John Bunch on piano and Ted Nash on saxophone.

ctx.x: Yeah. He played electric bass and standup bass. Cranshaw – Bobby Cranshaw. I’m sorry. I’ve got to remember all these names.
He’s working with Sonny Rollins now, still.
